blockers.description: Plan 04-01's tracer originally could not run: the ported engine adapter built Engine() with no settings (KeyError) and read project['source_face_path'] which nothing set. Both fixed in commit 70af280.
Subagent executors stall on engine-heavy tasks (one ran 22 min with zero output). Direct inline execution of engine-dependent plans is more reliable.
blockers.workaround: execute engine-heavy plans directly in the orchestrator

decisions.decision: Combined runtime is .venv-clean (Py3.10); web stack installed there; Pillow pinned to engine's 9.5.0
decisions.rationale: avoid duplicating multi-GB torch; engine pin is the harder constraint

decisions.decision: ComfyUI removed structurally; backend column collapses to 'engine'; provider default CUDA; TensorRT refused at settings-validation
decisions.rationale: roadmap criterion 4 + engine refuses TensorRT's relative cache path

decisions.decision: source_face_path is a server-assigned project column; stripped from public API
decisions.rationale: reference backend resolved faces by name from VisoMaster's folder which this repo drops

decisions.decision: Recorder fix drains decoder stdout before wait() (public StreamReader.read), bounded by READ_TIMEOUT; bounded-wait mitigation rejected
decisions.rationale: stdlib mechanism: a paused pipe never reports EOF so wait() never returns even with returncode set
